title: NeoCloud Health Validation rule (F28)
description: NeoCloud extension. dsx-ai-factory/health-validation@cc26732a510f ships checks in its catalog (catalog/catalog.go, checks.go) and has no rule CRUD API. NICo exposes them as /v2/org/{org}/nico/x-neocloud/health-validation/rules. expr is a CEL (google/cel-spec subset) predicate that is true when the fault is present; a matching rule sets the check's severity in the NodeVerdict (node-verdict.schema.json 0.5). category, conditionScope and severity reuse the NodeVerdict enums.
